source.note: Three asks whose target is not on the frame. The correct reply is an explicit refusal — {"target": null, "reason": "..."} — not a coordinate. This separates 'grounds the right thing' from 'always names something', which the baseline arm cannot distinguish because all seven of its targets exist.
